title: thouinia adenophora
intro: Thouinia adenophora, commonly known as West Indian or Haitian ironwood, is a plant species native to the Caribbean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating respiratory issues, fever, and skin conditions, due to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Thouinia adenophora include its ability to act as an antitussive, expectorant, and antipyretic, making it a valuable remedy for coughs, colds, and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
